company.description: Allianz SE, together with its subsidiaries, provides property-casualty insurance, life/health insurance, and asset management products and services worldwide. The company's Property-Casualty segment offers various insurance products, including motor liability, accident, fire and property, general liability, credit, and travel, and assistance services to private and corporate customers. Its Life/Health segment provides a range of life and health insurance products on an individual and a group basis, such as annuities, endowment and term insurance, and unit-linked and investment-oriented products, as well as private and supplemental health, and long-term care insurance products. The company's Asset Management segment offers institutional and retail asset management products and services to third-party investors comprising equity and fixed income funds, cash, and multi-assets; and alternative investment products that include real estate, infrastructure debt/equity, real assets, liquid alternatives, and solutions business. In addition, it provides banking services for retail clients; and digital investment services. Allianz SE was founded in 1890 and is headquartered in Munich, Germany.

evidence.quote: The Chiba Bank, Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides banking products and services in Japan and internationally. It offers time, installment time, and foreign currency deposits; loan products, such as home, card, car, education, home renovation, personal, and other loans; credit and debit cards; and asset management products, including investment trusts, NISA, Walthnavi, public debt, defined contribution pension plan, and other asset management products. The company also provides insurance products comprising pension insurance, whole life insurance, medical insurance and cancer insurance, long-term care and dementia insurance, disability insurance, term life insurance, and endowment insurance; and testamentary trust and estate settlement services. In addition, it offers corporate products and services comprising fundraising business portal, Web-EB service, cashless payment, accounting and collection rationalization service, business and management support, and business succession support; internet services, foreign exchange services, and safe deposit boxes. Further, the company holds securities consisting of bonds, stocks, and investment trusts for investment and operating purposes. The Chiba Bank, Ltd. was incorporated in 1943 and is based in Chiba, Japan.
